notes: Positions only: where in the program ROM the palette of each sprite piece record (its number at 0x122B74) starts; tools/palette_census.py writes it.

'drawn': the palette the sprite piece record (its number at 0x122B74) was shown with in the scenarios; 'nearby': one no scenario shows, given the palette of the sprite piece record (its number at 0x122B74) before it; 'chosen': picked by hand where those are wrong (a frame caught during a flash, a neighbour's palette that is not its own), and used instead of them.
'formats': how each palette is kept in the program ROM: 'alternate' (the palette window's upper half: the low bits of blue, green and red in bits 14-12) or 'direct' (as palette RAM holds it).

'opaque': the frames drawn opaque (sprite entry bit 8: the end code is drawn as a color and the row goes on past it), 'drawn' so in the scenarios or 'nearby' (a frame no scenario draws, drawn the way of the frame before it).
'bits8': the records drawn 8 bits a pen (the census, else the pieces that name them, else the record before); the rest are 4.
